kurals.tr: Pullaa Thiraaap Pulaththai Avar / Urum Allalnoi Kaankam Siridhu
kurals.m: Let us witness awhile his keen suffering; just feign dislike and embrace him not

kurals.tr: Uppamain Thatraal Pulavi Adhusiridhu / Mikkatraal Neela Vital
kurals.m: A little dislike is like salt in proportion; to prolong it a little is like salt a little too much

kurals.tr: Alandhaarai Allalnoi Seydhatraal Thammaip / Pulandhaaraip Pullaa Vital
kurals.m: For men not to embrace those who have feigned dislike is like torturing those already in agony

kurals.tr: Ooti Yavarai Unaraamai Vaatiya / Valli Mudhalarin Thatru
kurals.m: Not to reconcile those who have feigned dislike is like cutting a faded creeper at its root

kurals.tr: Nalaththakai Nallavarkku Eer Pulaththakai / Pooanna Kannaar Akaththu
kurals.m: An increased shyness in those whose eyes are like flowers is beautiful even to good and virtuous husbands

kurals.tr: Thuniyum Pulaviyum Illaayin Kaamam / Kaniyum Karukkaayum Atru
kurals.m: Sexual pleasure, without prolonged and short-lived dislike, is like too ripe, and unripe fruit

kurals.tr: Ootalin Untaangor Thunpam Punarvadhu / Neetuva Thandru Kol Endru
kurals.m: The doubt as to whether intercourse would take place soon or not, creates a sorrow (even) in feigned dislike

kurals.tr: Nodhal Evanmatru Nondhaarendru Aqdhariyum / Kaadhalar Illaa Vazhi
kurals.m: What avails sorrow when I am without a wife who can understand the cause of my sorrow?

kurals.tr: Neerum Nizhaladhu Inidhe Pulaviyum / Veezhunar Kanne Inidhu
kurals.m: Like water in the shade, dislike is delicious only in those who love

kurals.tr: Ootal Unanga Vituvaarotu Ennenjam / Kootuvem Enpadhu Avaa
kurals.m: It is nothing but strong desire that makes her mind unite with me who can leave her to her own dislike
